findings.title: The README states the location rules without the base commit

location.text: - **`fixed`**: the `location.text` must no longer appear anywhere in `location.file` as consecutive lines. If the fix deleted the file, the finding is accepted. `lines` keeps the original range and is not checked. `related` is not checked.

also.text: - **`open` and `declined`**: `location` and every `related` entry must exist, the line range must be within the file, and `text` must equal those lines.

findings.evidence: The check now reads the cited text at the base commit and checks the also locations; the two README lines describe neither.
findings.action: Rewrite both rules with the base commit and the also locations.
